_about: CANONICAL shared exclusion thresholds for the Teen AI Survey. Edit here, then run sync_qc.bat. JSON (not YAML) so it loads with the standard library in BOTH repos, including the analysis repo which does not depend on PyYAML. quality_filter.py reads this file if present; otherwise it uses identical embedded defaults. Tune on real data BEFORE looking at outcomes, then freeze and record final values in QUALITY_CONTROL.md.
_recaptcha_error_note: Q_RecaptchaStatus == 'error' raises its own flag, independent of the numeric score. It is the strongest correlate of junk open-text (errored on ~45% of flagged responses vs ~9% of clean) and was previously unused. It is an ordinary counting flag, not a standalone exclusion: a privacy-browser teen whose only signal is a reCAPTCHA error is not dropped from analysis, but is routed to Hold for a human to review.
_straightline_note: Each group is one matrix sharing a response scale. Only the long matrices are listed: the three 8-item comfort grids and the 5-item attitudes grid. The 4-item access grids are intentionally omitted (a uniform answer across 4 items is too plausible to treat as straight-lining). Embedded attention-check columns (Q220, Q218, Q219) are intentionally NOT listed, so straight-lining and attention stay independent signals.
_opentext_note: Open-text content screen for the two free-text 'walk us through' boxes. cross_respondent_duplicate ignores answers that merely echo an answer-option (option_text below, matched by token Jaccard >= option_echo_jaccard) and requires at least duplicate_min_words / duplicate_min_chars, so option restatements by real teens never trip it.
option_text: an ai that keeps a record of your past work to give faster more personalized help
an ai that keeps no record of your work so nothing about you is stored
_fraud_blacklist_note: Blank = auto-discover data/fraud_blacklist.csv near this file or the export. When found, a completer whose cid or survey IP is on the list is exclude_recommended for ANALYSIS too (not just suppressed at payment). At payment the blacklist still routes to the Fraud bucket (never paid); this only ensures the same rows drop from the analysis sample.
_hard_exclude_note: Near-certain junk that excludes on its own, bypassing the >=2 combination rule (requiring a second flag is what let the LLM-paste cluster pass). recaptcha_error is deliberately NOT hard: it counts toward n_flags and routes to Hold, but does not drop a row from analysis by itself.
